snapshot_date.description: UTC calendar date the snapshot represents.

source_url.description: Public API endpoint the snapshot was built from.

source_fetched_at.description: fetchedAt reported by the API response.

upstream_unavailable.description: True when the API reported that an upstream source was unavailable.

lat.description: Latitude of the chokepoint reference point, decimal degrees.

lon.description: Longitude of the chokepoint reference point, decimal degrees.

status.description: Traffic-light badge for disruption_score: green (<20), yellow (20-49), red (>=50). Not an operational closure status.

war_risk_tier.description: War-risk tier derived from Lloyd's JWC Listed Areas and OSINT threat classification.

congestion_level.description: AIS-derived congestion level. Null when the AIS snapshot was unavailable.

active_warnings.description: Active NGA navigational warnings matched to the chokepoint.

ais_disruptions.description: Disruption events in the AIS snapshot matched to the chokepoint.

navigational_warnings_available.description: True when the NGA navigational-warning source returned a valid response, including an empty list.

ais_snapshot_available.description: True when the AIS snapshot source returned a valid response. Governs ais_disruptions and congestion_level.

transit_data_available.description: True when IMF PortWatch transit history was available this cycle. Governs transit_wow_change_pct.

transit_today_counts_available.description: True when the 24-hour AIS window held crossings for this chokepoint. Governs the transit_today_* counts.

transit_today_total.description: AIS transits in the last 24 hours, all vessel types. Null when not measured.

transit_today_tanker.description: Tanker transits in the last 24 hours. Null when not measured.

transit_today_cargo.description: Cargo transits in the last 24 hours. Null when not measured.

transit_today_other.description: Other-vessel transits in the last 24 hours. Null when not measured.

transit_wow_change_pct.description: Week-over-week change in transits, percent. Null when transit history was unavailable.

flow_ratio.description: Latest 7-day PortWatch average over the preceding baseline window of up to 90 days, clamped to 0.0-1.5. Null when no flow estimate exists.

flow_disrupted.description: True when each of the latest 3 daily flow ratios is below 85% of the baseline window. Null when no flow estimate exists.

flow_source.description: PortWatch coverage basis of flow_ratio: deadweight tonnage or vessel counts. Null when no flow estimate exists.
